candidats.description: DIEGO GARCIA (Sept. 21, 2019) Equipment Operator 3rd Class Joseph Wilson, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion (NMCB) 4, uses screeding board to distribute and level out concrete. NMCB 4 is forward-deployed throughout the Indo-Pacific region ready to support major combat operations, humanitarian assistance and disaster relief and to provide general engineering and civil support to U.S. and joint forces. (U.S. Navy photo by Builder 3rd Class Emma R. Soflin/Released)

candidats.description: Monument de Joseph Sec , 8 avenue Pasteur, Aix-en-Provence, France. Rare exemple d’architecture Révolutionnaire, ce cénotaphe fut édifié en 1792.
